Something else to consider, is that blunt head trauma is quite serious, and entirely classable as "deadly force". All it takes is one strike in just the right place, and Whack!, that head will split open faster than an overripe melon. Since the assailed has no idea what is in that purse (Bag of puppies and throw pillows? Or bag of bricks and lead fishing sinkers?
